confirmed.statement: S1 recruited 50 undergraduate English majors: 25 male and 25 female students, aged 18-22, in the NUML Islamabad Communication Skills course in spring 2024. Recruitment was purposive; the institution is in Pakistan.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 4 (journal p. 3287), section 3.1, first two paragraphs; PDF p. 1 (journal p. 3284), affiliation 1.

confirmed.statement: S1 explicitly randomly divided those 50 students into two groups of 25, one non-AI control and one AI experimental group. This supports both arm n_randomized values of 25 and the study total of 50.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 4 (journal p. 3287), section 3.1, final sentence; section 3.2 specifies a between-subjects design.

confirmed.statement: The quantitative comparison explicitly reports AI n = 25 and non-AI n = 25, supporting both arm n_analyzed values and the 50-person total. Table 1 reports t(48) for the four outcomes, consistent with that total.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 5 (journal p. 3288), section 4.1, second paragraph and Table 1; PDF p. 6 (journal p. 3289), sections 4.3-4.5.

confirmed.statement: The arm counts refer to students. Ideas are the scored outputs, and the two trained raters are separate from the student sample; neither output counts nor rater counts are added to the 50 people.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 4 (journal p. 3287), sections 3.1 and 3.2.1; PDF p. 5 (journal p. 3288), section 3.2.2.3 and section 4.1.

confirmed.statement: Exclusions, withdrawals, missing-data losses, and attrition are not reported. The paper has no participant-flow diagram or appended participant accounting; equal reported assignment and analysis counts do not establish that no exclusions occurred.
confirmed.locator: Full markdown read, lines 1-495, corresponding to PDF pp. 1-13; counts in sections 3.1 and 4.1, PDF pp. 4-5; Figures 1-2, PDF pp. 6-7, are results charts; References end on PDF p. 13.

confirmed.statement: Only one experimental cohort is described. Each participant also wrote a post-task reflection, and 50 reflections underwent thematic analysis; these texts and the repeated reflective-writing methods describe no additional recruited sample.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 4 (journal p. 3287), sections 3.1-3.2.2.1; PDF p. 5 (journal p. 3288), section 3.2.3; PDF p. 6 (journal p. 3289), section 4.6.

confirmed.statement: No reuse of participants from another paper is disclosed. Cross-paper overlap remains unconfirmed, consistent with the form recording null rather than asserting that no overlap exists.
confirmed.locator: Full document, PDF pp. 1-13 (markdown lines 1-495), especially the sample description in section 3.1, PDF p. 4, and References, PDF pp. 11-13.

confirmed.statement: A source inconsistency remains: the Figure 2 discussion describes reflections from fifty students who used ChatGPT, whereas the methods and quantitative comparison specify 25 AI students. It provides no revised quantitative sample count or second randomization.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 7 (journal p. 3290), section 4.6, first sentence below Figure 2; compare PDF p. 4, section 3.1, and PDF p. 5, section 4.1.

confirmed.statement: Collaborative idea production is explicit, but how the authors constructed individual scores or handled dependence within groups is unexplained. The form already acknowledges this limitation; it does not change the explicitly reported number of students.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 4 (journal p. 3287), section 3.2.1; PDF p. 5 (journal p. 3288), section 4.1 and Table 1; PDF p. 6 (journal p. 3289), section 4.4 describes participant scores.

confirmed.statement: S1 alone reaches criterion 2 exactly: 25 analyzed AI students plus 25 analyzed control students equals 50 people, without combining separate studies or counting reflections as extra participants.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 4 (journal p. 3287), sections 3.1-3.2; PDF p. 5 (journal p. 3288), section 4.1.

summary: The form's 50-person total and 25-person arm counts match explicit randomized and analyzed counts, so criterion 2 holds. The qualitative text inconsistently describes 50 ChatGPT users, but reports no revised quantitative count; exclusions and cross-paper overlap remain unreported.
